{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = completed_orders[qa_mask]

# Remove QA orders from the completed set
real_completed_orders = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue on real completed orders
mean_revenue_real = real_completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Number of QA orders in completed: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_real}')"}
